2608.01023.title: Caliber: Cross-Architecture Extraction-Cost Control for Score-Returning APIs
2608.01023.paper_summary: We present Caliber, an output-perturbation defense against model extraction that formulates noise selection as a calibration problem: how much the defense degrades the supervision signal used to train a surrogate, and the provable per-input query cost of recovering the clean logits. To defend against an attacker that uses returned scores for knowledge distillation, Caliber adds independent and identically distributed Gaussian noise to the internal logits. We establish two properties of the resulting perturbed predictions. Monotone agreement degradation: When the clean logits have a unique maximizer, agreement with the clean prediction decreases strictly with the noise scale, so every target in $(1/K,1)$ corresponds to a unique positive scale; task accuracy is bounded by computable lower and upper envelopes. Per-input recovery cost: We derive a closed-form minimax lower bound on the repeated queries needed to recover the clean logits for a fixed input. Caliber normalizes noise variance by the squared median top-two logit margin and fits the resulting noise-utility relationship with a logistic curve, either per model or shared within a task. Across more than thirty model-dataset combinations, per-model calibration achieves mean absolute relative errors of 0.6-1.4%. End-to-end experiments show that surrogate performance generally tracks the configured degradation, while fixed-input averaging follows the expected variance reduction.
2608.01023.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出 Caliber，一種針對模型提取的輸出擾動防禦，將噪聲選擇公式化為一個校準問題：防禦對用於訓練替代模型的監督信號的降級程度，以及恢復乾淨邏輯的每個輸入查詢的可證明成本。為了防禦使用返回分數進行知識蒸餾的攻擊者，Caliber 向內部邏輯添加獨立同分佈的高斯噪聲。我們確立了擾動預測的兩個特性。單調一致性降級：當乾淨邏輯具有唯一的最大化者時，與乾淨預測的一致性隨著噪聲規模的增加而嚴格減少，因此在 $(1/K,1)$ 中的每個目標對應於一個唯一的正規模；任務準確性受到可計算的下限和上限包絡線的限制。每個輸入的恢復成本：我們推導出一個封閉形式的最小最大下界，該下界用於恢復固定輸入的乾淨邏輯所需的重複查詢。Caliber 通過平方中位數前兩個邏輯邊際來標準化噪聲方差，並用邏輯曲線擬合結果噪聲-效用關係，無論是每個模型還是任務內共享。在三十多個模型-數據集組合中，每個模型的校準達到了 0.6-1.4% 的平均絕對相對誤差。端到端實驗顯示，替代模型的性能通常跟蹤配置的降級，而固定輸入平均則遵循預期的方差減少。
